description: All Leeds DC inbound and outbound flows move to the new DC in one cutover weekend
rollback_notes: No rollback once the weekend cutover completes: the old DC is decommissioned for stock that has moved

description: Regions move to the new DC in three waves with a go/no-go gate before each wave
freeze_window: Last wave would land inside the peak freeze
rollback_notes: Each wave can be reversed until its gate is passed; stock not yet moved stays in the old DC

description: Old and new DC run side by side on live orders until volumes reconcile
rollback_notes: Full rollback at any point because the old DC stays live; needs double staffing through peak
